repairedGroups: Deadline guards before and after relevant calls, including canonical verification, content reads and final completion; returned owned FDs are registered before post-call deadline checks.
Artifact lifecycle and exact four-entry completeness validation; partial removal seals the store, preserves the original error and refuses verification or removal retry.
FD and exclusive-connection close outcomes remain sticky after failure; repeated calls retain the original failure rather than reporting success or retrying unknown handles.

independentReview.scope: three approved boundary repair groups and their regression tests

limitations: Before/after deadline checks cannot preempt an in-progress operating-system call.
Linux filesystem and D-Bus tests use local test doubles, not actual native services.
FIFO stream pump, verified native parent-fd acquisition, native connector, kernel/resource attestation and session/original-worker integration remain pending.
synchronization: Sanitized verification record only; no private experimental source, credentials or raw errors published.
